tezera organiser · until verified

How the organiser web portal looks from sign-up until an admin verifies the account. Same onboarding as the main organiser flow, then a new account with nothing set up yet: what works straight away, what stays locked (stall slots, job posts and booking requests), and how verification moves from not started to pending, rejected and approved. Use the flow map to see each journey, or click through the screens: highlighted areas are real links.

About these screens
  • Palette is the Organiser palette from brand manual v1.1: slate #526C80 primary, sage #70A98D secondary, #6F908B accent on #D7DFEA. Dark uses the manual's organiser dark set (#7F9AAD on #151D28).
  • Locked items are drawn as they appear to an unverified organiser, with a lock mark and the reason. The established, verified account is in the main organiser flow file.
  • Small tags on screens (Should, Could, Proposed, To decide) carry the priority notes from the mind map.
  • Yellow hotspots show a message instead of changing screen (for example Apply or Mark received). Download SVG saves the current screen so it can be dropped into Figma.
